payload.summary: Interest and effort may finally move in the same direction without turning the exchange into a chase.
payload.body: Interest and effort may finally move in the same direction without turning the exchange into a chase. Venus trine Mars can help payment clear, an invitation land, or a creative partnership begin with both sides contributing what they said they would. The ease comes from reciprocity, not passivity. Keep it that way. Let each person carry a visible part of the work, cost, or initiative so nobody has to keep proving that the agreement matters by doing more than their share.
